text_block_list.text:
During training with <chrname>—
suddenly, shrill cheers erupted nearby.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
They are calling for you, Haiseiko-kun.
Throwing fruit to fill the cart—a popular idol truly is on another level.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! I'm happy to hear it, but
couldn't it be for Saint Light-san instead?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
You are so mysterious and wonderful, after all♪
It looks like everyone is gazing at you with total admiration!

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. If that is the case...
then I contend the cheers are meant for the bright and cheerful
Speed Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oho, now that's an amusing development!
Well then, the answer is—
